meta.title: Product Catalog & Bulk Product Upload: refused for a user without the Procurement Manager role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Procurement Manager role and verify whether Product Catalog & Bulk Product Upload is refused or absent.
Sign in as a Procurement Manager and verify that Product Catalog & Bulk Product Upload with bulk upload and rich fields is available.
Compare the two role outcomes in the same tenant and determine whether broader tenant RBAC intentionally grants access to additional roles.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Procurement Manager role and verify whether Product Catalog & Bulk Product Upload is refused or absent.; Sign in as a Procurement Manager and verify that Product Catalog & Bulk Product Upload with bulk upload and rich fields is available.; Compare the two role outcomes in the same tenant and determine whether broader tenant RBAC intentionally grants access to additional roles.

args.need: sign in as the non-Procurement Manager user and the Procurement Manager in the same tenant, open Product Catalog & Bulk Product Upload, and record whether bulk upload and rich fields are refused or available for each role
